_note: The two binaries SWARM Node runs, pinned by SHA-256, one block per network profile.
Read only by scripts/fetch-pinned-binaries.mjs, which both workflows call.
The release is a transport; these hashes are the trust anchor. A build whose
download does not hash to the value here fails, whatever tag it came from.
Changing a hash here changes which code a user's machine executes: it is a
release decision, and the source commit and workflow run that produced each
set are recorded beside it so the claim can be checked.

swarm-testnet.repo_note: Empty means THIS repository. swarm-node is private, and a private repository's GITHUB_TOKEN cannot read another repository's workflow artifacts, so the testnet tools are carried in a pre-release of this repo. See run 35636846516 for what happens otherwise.

swarm-mainnet.previous: replaced vendored-binaries-mainnet-3 (5f6c19488b654cc7d3e92c5686c0346df4f04ba1) for the relaunch of 2026-10-02
swarm-mainnet.requires: A zebrad built with Network::SwarmMain, from privacy-zebra 16c6a210f or later. An older zebrad rejects [network.swarm_main] while deserialising its configuration, and one older than 16c6a210f also rejects the `initial_swarm_main_peers` key this app writes under [network] - without which a node cannot be pointed at seed-main.swarm.green at all. Shielded mining on more than one core additionally needs bd32e36ac or later: an older zebrad does not know `[mining] internal_miner_threads`. See docs/NETWORK-PROFILES.md.
